split: Per Fold/seed whole target Batch: Evaluation=floor(N/2); remaining rows candidate pool. Evaluation per-gas Hamilton allocation with >=1 and <=n_g-1; ties lower gas id. Per-gas SeedSequence(seed,target_batch,gas) permutation, first quota Evaluation, rest pool.
calibration: Counts floor(N*rate/100), denominator full target Batch. Start1 per gas; sequential proportional-deficit fill using pool class counts, capacity-capped, tie lower gas id. Same per-gas pool permutation prefix for5/10/20 so nested.
impossible: If any class<2 or calibration target<6 or capacity insufficient, stop before fits; no class synthesis, silent relaxation, new seed or ratio.
labels: True labels used for retrospective stratified split. Only selected calibration labels enter refit. Collecting class-balanced calibration prospectively may require controlled gas exposures/additional labels; percentages are training-label counts, not proven deployment cost.
temporal: Past Train precedes target Batch. Calibration/Evaluation are random same-Batch subsets; no exact within-Batch timestamps, so not proof of chronological online adaptation.
pipeline: Train-only median imputer -> StandardScaler -> SVC. Refit from scratch on past+calibration. balanced n/(6*n_g) from combined Train labels only; no sample_weight.
metric: Accuracy, MacroF1 present true classes, WeightedF1, per-gas P/R/F1/support/predicted_n, 6x6 confusion, zero recall, directional focus errors. Unsupported truth NA not zero.
aggregation: Primary: for each seed equal3-Fold MacroF1 mean, then equal3-seed mean. Per-gas supported-Fold mean within seed then equal-seed mean; other-four F1 equal gas means1,2,3,5. Seed SD ddof1 descriptive only; overlapping repeated data.
consistency: A requires all3 Fold mean paired MacroF1 deltas>1e-12, >=2/3 seed mean deltas>1e-12 and>=6/9 paired Fold-seed deltas>1e-12, plus all guards.
conclusion: Per rate independently: A if guards+consistency; B otherwise if any paired Fold-seed MacroF1 gain>1e-12 or any gas aggregate F1 gain>1e-12; C otherwise. Do not pick a winning ratio or replace official Model A.
regression: Fold A only: existing B_history Validation Batch4 and Test Batch5,358 rows, five true gas classes with no Toluene. Re-register as past held-out retention diagnostic, not independent future test; disjoint from Train1-3 and target6. B/C no past rows outside full past Train; retention unavailable. No Train-score proxy.
reuse: Verify source sha, Train medians/scaler/support vectors/classes/params before fitting. If unavailable stop and report required replacements, do not train extra baseline.
stop: No tuning, extra seeds/ratios, feature selection, weighting experiment, new algorithm, ensemble, drift detector or Batch9/10 scientific evaluation. Fit failure recorded; no altered retry. Leakage or preservation failure aborts.
warning: 정답이 확인된 새 시기 자료를 이용한 지도학습 모델 적응이며 물리적 센서 교정이나 드리프트 감지 실험이 아님. 반복 사용한 개발 Batch 내부의 평가이며 독립 Test가 아님. Batch 9~10 신규 평가 없음. 공식 Model A 유지.
